description: This Java class named 'InterestIncentiveDataValidator' performs validation of JSON input data related to interest incentive configurations in a financial software system, specifically for create and update operations. It checks the presence, types, and validity of various parameters, and ensures compliance with enumerated types.

classes.name: InterestIncentiveDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating interest incentive data in JSON format for create and update operations in the system.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a new interest incentive, checking for unsupported parameters, parsing the JSON, and enforcing required fields and types.

methods.name: validateIncentiveCreate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of incentive creation parameters like entity type, attribute name, condition type, attribute value, incentive type, and amount.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing interest incentive, with similar checks as create but allowing optional parameters.

methods.name: validateIncentiveUpdate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of incentivize update parameters such as description, entity type, attribute name, condition type, attribute value, incentive type, and amount.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if validation errors have been accumulated.
